These fixtures are synthetic printed recipe documents generated by
`node scripts/create-recipe-test-fixtures.mjs`. The JPEG and PNG have a small
rotation, paper background and lighting gradient. The PDF contains the same
raster image and must pass through the actual local PDF decoder and OCR.
They test representative document extraction, not real kitchen photography or
handwriting accuracy. No handwriting samples or private invoice photos were
available in this checkout. Expected: 10 portions, 1000 g chicken breast,
500 g onions, 800 ml coconut milk; method text is not an ingredient.
